conversation: I work in quality control at a security printing company that prints banknotes and passports. When I told my supervisor I was pregnant in April, my contract was not renewed in May.
I am sorry to hear that. Did they give you a reason?

They said my performance was low, but I had a good evaluation in January. Two other women in my department also lost their contracts after they announced pregnancies, one in 2023 and one in February this year.
Is there anything else about how women are treated at the company?
Women in quality control earn less than men doing the same inspection work. A male colleague with the same job and less experience told me his salary, it is about 20 percent more.
Do you have documents, such as the evaluation or the contract notice?
I have the January evaluation at home and the email about the contract. I am afraid to make it official because the sector is small and I could be blacklisted.
